infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: The Pulse Network requires access to your fine location to map your intent broadcasts onto local proximity geohash cells securely without server tracking footprints.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: The Pulse Network utilizes native FaceID biometric authentication to verify owner presence and lock down the secure Developer Administration Console against unauthorized scripts.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow The Pulse Network to use FaceID to secure your administrative local developer logs.
